title: BPW-2026-0541
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0541
CD 3, 5, 11
TEMPORARY FULL CLOSURE – SEPULVEDA BOULEVARD AT THE SEPULVEDA BOULEVARD TUNNEL NEAR MULHOLLAND DRIVE
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE a temporary full closure of Sepulveda Boulevard at the Sepulveda Boulevard Tunnel near Mulholland Drive from November 18, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. to November 19, 2026, at 5:00 a.m. to facilitate site investigation, condition assessment, and digital scanning activities associated with the Sepulveda Boulevard Tunnel near Mulholland Drive Phase 1 - Emergency Structural Repairs Project.
summary: Full closure of Sepulveda Boulevard at the Sepulveda Tunnel near Mulholland Drive from 9 p.m. on November 18 to 5 a.m. on November 19, 2026, so engineers can inspect and digitally scan the tunnel ahead of emergency structural repairs.

locations.text: Sepulveda Boulevard Tunnel near Mulholland Drive, Los Angeles, CA
